title: Lots of people are now playing Mad Snake! :D
author: Appropriate-Value610
selftext:
Hey everyone, 

Solo dev here building Mad Snake, a retro arcade snake game for iOS. 

I launched Mad Snake about \~3 months ago, and built it 100% on Claude Code and superpowers plugin. 

I prioritised not just speed, but quality. This include unit testing, scalable code, and tried my best to come up with a smooth user experience and nice gameplay :)

I'm getting close to \~500 monthly active players, driving traffic mostly via SEO, social media, Reddit, LinkedIn, etc.

I also leveraged Claude Code to build the website, including localisation to 10 different languages.

See attached a product demo. The game is free and available on the App Store, enjoy it! ;)
